items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: I never played with the Mountain City Blue Blowers, but McKenzie was there with them, and McKenzie was the kind of man who could sell things.

ctx.x: Well, I never played with the Mountain City Blue Blowers, but McKenzie was there with them, and McKenzie was the kind of man who could sell things.

Musicians were never people who could go -- jazz musicians could never go call up a man who ran a recording company and sell themselves. Condon could do it, McKenzie could do it, as they were later to prove.
